summary: v3 preserves the map and removes pseudo-writing, but the uniform double-outline capsules read as dashed routes and the broad relief remains visually absent.
required_changes: Replace only the thirty dark capsule crests with short, irregular, tapered, low-contrast single-line terrain strokes; preserve the ten detached hatches and every other pixel class.
